description: Propose and prepare an owner-authorized constitutional amendment with synchronized consumers.

## User Input

```text
$ARGUMENTS
```

## Authority

`.specify/memory/constitution.md` is an existing governing contract, not a blank
template. Read it, especially sections 0 and 22, before making a proposal.
If missing, stop and ask; do not initialize or overwrite it automatically.
ADR 0019 consumer edits remain Proposed until the required acceptance PR.

## Workflow

1. Identify the requested policy change and actual conflicts. Preserve substantive
   safeguards and historical evidence; never infer owner approval from silence.
2. Read relevant accepted ADRs, active instructions, and the authorizing work.
   Propose one bounded ADR, version bump with rationale, affected consumers,
   acceptance route, and rollback. Do not mark it Accepted.
3. Obtain explicit owner authorization for local edits to locked artifacts and
   the section 22 PR route. Preparation, commit/push/PR creation, acceptance,
   installations, and live settings are distinct permissions.
4. Prepare the local amendment using the current document, not a placeholder
   generator. Keep the accepted baseline and pending activation visible.
   Do not advance ratification/last-amended metadata before acceptance.
5. Synchronize actual consumers: repository instructions, active agents/prompts,
   SpecKit templates, authorized charters/routing/ceremonies, contributor/testing
   docs, and PR template. Discover paths; do not assume a templates/commands
   directory exists. Never rewrite accepted ADR bodies or historical logs.
6. Update the Sync Impact Report and proposed revision-history entry with
   changed sections, consumer paths, and explicit pending automation/exceptions.
7. Check authority, principle references, gates, review restrictions, branching,
   archival, approval boundaries, and lifecycle evidence across all consumers.
   Executable policy changes need behavior/fixture evidence as applicable;
   unexecuted checks remain pending, not passed.
8. Report prepared versus verified/accepted work, unresolved decisions, and the
   next required approval. Follow section 22's PR, announcement, and acceptance
   requirements only when separately authorized.

Existing blocks retain their original author restrictions. Do not use an
amendment to self-clear, archive unresolved evidence, or authorize a release.
